Important Safety & Usage Disclaimer

This 26-inch mountain electric bike is only for private off-road, mountain trails and outdoor recreational use. It is not engineered for daily city street or public road commuting. Electric bicycle laws vary widely across all US states; all riders must check local traffic regulations before any on-street riding. A certified safety helmet is required for all riding activities.

ZNH 26" Off-Road Mountain E-Bike Overview

Built for adult riders aged 16 and above, this mountain ebike features a powerful 1000W peak (500W continuous) brushless motor paired with a UL2849 certified 52V 13Ah removable lithium battery, hitting a maximum speed of 22 MPH and offering up to 70 miles range in pedal assist mode. Perfect for mountain, gravel, dirt and private trail leisure riding.

Main Features

High-torque motor for steep mountain climbs and rough off-road terrain

Detachable battery for easy charging indoors, full UL2849 safety certification

Shimano 21-speed shifting adapts to all trail gradient conditions

Clear LCD display to track speed, mileage and battery level in real time

Sturdy mixed alloy frame with rear luggage rack for outdoor gear storage

IPX4 water resistance for light rain outdoor trail riding
